The regression range is 202210010601 to 202210020606. The commit `cc44cacb5 loadProjection(): avoid write heap-bufer-overflow on invalid PROJECTION block` is in that range. But the crash is a heap-use-after-free in `msFreeMap`. Let me look at the `loadProjection` function and how it interacts with `msFreeMap`.

Let me first check the current state of the code and look at `loadProjection`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/MapServer && grep -n "loadProjection" mapfile.c | head -10</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
